Who We Are

GC International AG, based in Lucerne, is a global leader in dental care and oral health. With more than 100 years of history, presence in over 100 countries, and a team of over 3,500 people worldwide, we are proud to support dental professionals with innovative, high-quality products that truly make a difference for patients.

Our teams across Europe, North America, and Asia work together to develop and manufacture precision components for the dental industry, always focused on quality, innovation, and improving lives.

At GC, we believe in working with care and purpose. Our company philosophy, SEMUI, is all about thinking from the standpoint of others, whether that’s our customers, our teams, or the people who use our products every day. It’s this mindset that helps us drive innovation, respect each other, and create real value for the future of oral health.

If you’re looking to join a successful, global company with real career opportunities, we’d love to meet you.


About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Sustainability Reporting & Data Analyst (m/f/d) to support the delivery of our Group-wide sustainability strategy through reliable ESG reporting, robust data management, and meaningful analysis.

Based in Lucerne, you will coordinate sustainability data collection across our international organization, strengthen reporting processes and controls, and monitor progress against sustainability objectives.

This is a hands-on analytical and coordination role, in which you will work closely with corporate, regional, and local stakeholders. You will help ensure that sustainability data is accurate, consistent, and audit-ready, while supporting the continuous development of our ESG reporting processes and systems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Coordinate Group-wide ESG data collection, consolidation and reporting, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and clear documentation.
  • Prepare ESG KPIs, dashboards, and sustainability disclosures, analyzing trends and progress against targets.
  • Support GHG accounting across Scope 1, 2 and relevant Scope 3 categories, alongside analysis of energy, water, waste, and emissions.
  • Contribute to the annual sustainability reporting and coordinate data inputs for applicable regulatory requirements, including PPWR, CBAM, DDTrO etc.
  • Strengthen ESG controls, audit trails, and processes supporting external assurance.
  • Support the implementation of an ESG reporting tool - from requirements definition and data migration to testing and user training.
  • Guide data owners and support broader sustainability, risk, and reporting initiatives across the Group.


Your Profile

  • Degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Relevant experience in sustainability/ESG reporting, data management, or business analysis, including coordinating reporting cycles across multiple stakeholders.
  • Practical knowledge of ESG indicators and GHG accounting, including the GHG Protocol and Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions.
  • Strong Excel and data-analysis skills, with experience validating datasets and investigating inconsistencies.
  • Experience with reporting systems, databases, or data collection platforms; system implementation, BI, or automation experience is a plus.
  • Experience with sustainability disclosures, audit and assurance processes is a plus.
  • Structured and analytical approach with strong attention to detail and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and reporting deadlines.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills. Japanese language skills will be an asset.


Why Join GC International AG

At GC International AG, you will be part of a growing, innovative company with a global footprint. We offer a collaborative, international work environment where your expertise makes a direct impact.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our global organization and contribute directly to the further development of our sustainability reporting, data and governance processes.
